subject: Evaluation asset exchange & gating: proposed handoff checklist and close timeline
messages:
From: Samira Nadeem <samira@brightretail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: data@brightretail.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval asset exchange + MAP request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. BrightRetail is ready to move forward with a short evaluation but we need to formalize the exchange and gating so legal/security can approve. High-level asks:

- We will provide a seed evaluation dataset (~20k records) plus a small prompt pack and an initial set of 150 test cases.
- Usage constraints: offline evaluation only (no production inference), no redistribution, retention limited to 90 days, and aggregate reporting only (no raw customer fields to leave BrightRetail domain).
- We need a mutual action plan outlining milestones (handoff, interim results, final acceptance) and a proposed close/exit checklist.

Attached is a short requirements doc from our security team (BrightRetail_eval_requirements.pdf). Can Redwood share an official handoff checklist and the prompt pack licensing terms? We also need a DPA/DPA redline if necessary.

Target timeline from our side: handoff as early as July 26, interim readout by Aug 9, and final close by Aug 23. That said, security sign-off is the gating item.

Appreciate a concise MAP and any artifacts you need us to produce early to speed approval.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Nadeem
Head of Data Science — BrightRetail

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Samira Nadeem <samira@brightretail.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval asset exchange + MAP request

Hi Samira — thanks, this is clear and totally doable. Quick response with a proposed MAP and gated handoff checklist below; I attached a spreadsheet (RI_eval_handoff_checklist_v1.xlsx) that breaks items into owner/action/date. Also attaching a restricted prompt pack (promptpack_restricted_v1.zip) and a redline of the DPA for your legal (redlined_DPA.docx).

Proposed MAP (high level)
- T0 (handoff prep, Jul 20–25): legal sign-off on DPA, completion of dataset de-ident checklist, and creation of secure Access bucket. (Owners: BrightRetail & Redwood security)
- T1 (handoff, Jul 26): BrightRetail uploads seed dataset to secure exchange; Redwood confirms schema and copies to isolated evaluation workspace.
- T2 (initial evaluation, Jul 27–Aug 6): Redwood runs baseline runs, internal quality checks, and shares interim metrics (accuracy by test case groups, token cost estimates).
- T3 (readout, Aug 9): joint interim readout and decision on extended tests.
- T4 (final acceptance & close, by Aug 23): mutual acceptance criteria met, retention teardown scheduled (90-day retention enforced; earlier wipe if requested).

Gating checklist (summary)
- Signed DPA (BrightRetail legal) — REQUIRED before dataset transfer
- Data inventory + classification confirmation (BrightRetail)
- Secure upload to our S3-compatible staging (BrightRetail action)
- Access grant to named Redwood engineers only (Jonas/Kimberly/Karthik)
- No-production clause explicitly documented in MAP & DPA

License/usage constraints we propose to include in the MAP (we will mirror your constraints):
- Offline evaluation only, no production calls
- No redistribution of raw dataset
- Retention limited to 90 days after final acceptance; immediate deletion upon request
- Aggregated metrics only for reporting (no exported raw PII)

A few asks from our side so we can prepare the handoff spreadsheet:
1) Confirm the exact file formats and a sample schema (CSV + manifest preferred)
2) Confirm the BrightRetail contact who will do the secure upload (Samira, is that you or a separate admin?)
3) Any additional masking requirements beyond the checklist in your attachment?

If that timeline looks good I will: 1) send a DocuSign link for the DPA redline for review, 2) create the secure upload folder and send credentials to the named contact, and 3) schedule the joint readout on Aug 9 (60 minutes).

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Eval asset exchange + MAP request — internal notes

Kimberly / Karthik — forwarding the BrightRetail thread. Quick internal notes & action items before I reply to legal and enable the upload: 

- Kimberly: can you confirm the storage path and that we can programmatically enforce 90-day lifecycle + immediate retention wipe on request? Also pick the minimal IAM group for access and create the staging folder (label: brightretail-eval-2026-07). Assign to me and you only.
- Karthik: after you take a look at their requirements doc, prepare recommended runtime/quantization profile we should test for the seed dataset (latency/cost vs quality tradeoffs), and a short note for the readout explaining expected token costs per scenario.
- Legal: I'll ping legal but please be ready for a quick DPA redline review — I attached a draft redline in the external reply.

Also flag: we should not include promptpack source examples that contain any BrightRetail proprietary synonyms — keep prompt examples abstracted. If in doubt, mask identifiers.

Thanks — short replies fine.

Jonas

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Eval asset exchange + MAP request — internal notes

Ack — will:
- Create secure folder brightretail-eval-2026-07 and send a link (Drive + S3 staging)

- Limit access to IAM group redwood-brightretail-eval (Jonas/Kim/Karthik)
